# Ledger Finality Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LedgerFinalityStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The finality state of a ledger transaction or block — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-finalityStatus.md) — the open set of individuals naming a ledger settlement state (pending, confirmed, finalized, orphaned, reorged).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-state subclasses (states are individuals) and avoid using it for the attestation verification verdict ([`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](gmeow-VerificationStatus.md)); finality is the chain-settlement state, not a check outcome.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md) individual via [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-finalityStatus.md), observed at a point in time; the status may change as the chain advances, and the determination runs in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Examples

- ex:tx1 [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-finalityStatus.md) [`gmeow:finalityStatusFinalized`](../individuals/gmeow-finalityStatusFinalized.md).
